flipToBack.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged; auto-fires whenever condition holds. OPPONENT-DRIVEN: fires when opponent's Dark Jedi shows up.
flipToBack.prose: Flip if an opponent's Dark Jedi is PRESENT at an interior Naboo battleground site (presentAt = actual presence at the site, spotting includes excluded-from-battle).

flipToFront.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged; auto-fires whenever condition holds. Flip is accompanied by retrieve 1 Force.
flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front (and owner retrieves 1 Force) if opponent has NO Dark Jedi present at any interior Naboo battleground site - exact negation of the front flip spot.

requirementSemantics: Flip trigger both ways is OPPONENT PRESENCE (Filters.presentAt), not control and not occupy: a single opponent Dark Jedi present at an interior Naboo battleground site flips front->back; zero such Dark Jedi flips back->front (+1 Force retrieval).
The objective's own side never flips it forward by board development; it toggles purely on opponent's Dark Jedi positioning. Both spots use SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE.
Back->front retrieval: FlipCardEffect followed by RetrieveForceEffect(playerId, 1) in the same required action. Card13_046_BACK.java:189-193
typedIdentities: Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.Jedi) - front drain-protection + targeting enabler; back drain/battle self-ban scope
